$gameId..read:
auth != null && (
          data.child('players').child('south').child('userId').val() === auth.uid ||
          data.child('players').child('north').child('userId').val() === auth.uid ||
          data.child('players').child('east').child('userId').val() === auth.uid ||
          data.child('players').child('west').child('userId').val() === auth.uid ||
          data.child('players').child('south').child('userId').val().beginsWith('ai_') ||
          data.child('players').child('north').child('userId').val().beginsWith('ai_') ||
          data.child('players').child('east').child('userId').val().beginsWith('ai_') ||
          data.child('players').child('west').child('userId').val().beginsWith('ai_')
        )
$gameId..write:
auth != null && (
          data.child('players').child('south').child('userId').val() === auth.uid ||
          data.child('players').child('north').child('userId').val() === auth.uid ||
          data.child('players').child('east').child('userId').val() === auth.uid ||
          data.child('players').child('west').child('userId').val() === auth.uid ||
          !data.exists()
        )
